claim: ETMR frames model modification as an evidence-thresholded scientific decision among KEEP, RECALIBRATE, REVISE, and ABSTAIN.
Quality, parameter, and structural evidence provide distinct decision functions within ETMR.
ETMR outperforms the structural-plus-quality baseline on the 800-case independent controlled benchmark.
The 800-case ETMR accuracy advantage is statistically robust within the controlled benchmark.
ETMR produced zero false structural revisions and zero missed structural revisions on the evaluated controlled benchmarks.
ETMR correctly handled deliberately constructed conflicts between parameter evidence, structural evidence, and evidence quality.
On the irrigation dataset, ETMR selected KEEP because neither structural nor parameter evidence was temporally reproducible.
ETMR is universally accurate for real-world scientific model revision.
ETMR achieves 98.12% accuracy on real irrigation data.
ETMR proves that rainfall is causally responsible for model discrepancy.
evidence: Current experiments do not establish causal identification
